audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart contradicted itself: phases[0]/win[0] said Skill while whys[0] says Urgot's 800-range Q out-ranges Parrrley (625); phases[3] said Urgot while whys[3] explicitly says 'call it skill'; phases[4]/win[4] said Urgot while whys[4] and spikes[1] call Level 6 'your one clean stage' and the packet chart says Gangplank.
audit.why: 47.45% over 725 games is a slightly Urgot-favoured lane, not a stage-by-stage loss, and the packet levelChart (Urgot, Urgot, Urgot, Skill, Gangplank, Skill, Urgot) matches the prose.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the packet chart in both layers, ratings rescaled to match.

audit.why: Spikes are keyed correctly: Urgot lvl 1-3 Q range, Gangplank level 6 Cannon Barrage, first item Sheen, late chained kegs. Kept the structure and only made the mechanics exact.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly attributes Urgot's shield to W (Purge) — 'before his W shield soaks it', 'a fight his W shield wins', 'Purge shreds you while shielding him'. Riot's text puts the shield on E (Disdain): 'Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself'. Purge has no shield.
audit.why: This inverts the punish window: you play around the E charge, not the W channel. Also, Purge's cooldown and cost fall to 0 at rank 5, so 'wait out his W' is wrong advice late.
audit.corrected: Shield moved onto Disdain everywhere; Disdain's real cooldown (16s at rank 1, 14s at rank 5) and R's 100/85/70 added; Remove Scurvy named as the W cleanse instead of 'Q-cleanse'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown advice was abstract ('track it before every engage') with no numbers.
audit.why: Disdain is the whole matchup and it is a 16s window at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Concrete 16s Disdain and 100s R figures written into the don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Q-cleanse his slow' / dosFull[2] titled 'Q-cleanse his slows'. Gangplank's cleanse is W, Remove Scurvy; Parrrley (Q) cleanses nothing.
audit.why: A player reading this will hold Q instead of W into the flip.
audit.corrected: Named Remove Scurvy (W) in tldr and the do's detail. The title string itself is 19 chars and under the applier's 25-char floor, so it is left for a title-level pass.

edits.before: His W shreds you — barrel-poke, Q-cleanse his slow. Gangplank wins the Disdain cooldown windows.
edits.after: Purge shreds you — barrel-poke, W-cleanse his slow. Punish the 16s Disdain window and stay above his R.

edits.before: Q-poke costs him HP and pays you gold. Identify how Urgot contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Corrosive Charge reaches 800 to your Parrrley's 625, so he pokes free — last-hit at max range, don't contest.

edits.before: Cannon Barrage wins fights you are not even in — watch the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Urgot's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage zones his walk-up and beats a dive — your one clean stage. Fear Beyond Death executes only below its threshold — stay above it.

edits.before: Urgot wastes Disdain (Flip) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Remove Scurvy cures his slow and heals — save it for his commit.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Disdain hurls you into Purge's 490 range; his E is down 16s at rank 1.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death executes below its threshold and his R is up every 100s at rank 1 — disengage first.

edits.before: With Sheen and a keg chain online both sides can burst, so the trade outcome comes down to whether you land the detonation before his W shield soaks it.
edits.after: With Sheen and a keg chain online both sides can burst, so the trade comes down to landing the detonation before Disdain's shield and flip soak it.

edits.before: Sheen/Essence Reaver plus a chained keg detonation lets you finally burst back, but his W (Purge) shreds you with rapid shots while shielding him, so trades land even rather than in your favor.
edits.after: Sheen/Essence Reaver plus a chained keg detonation lets you finally burst back, but Purge shreds you with rapid shots and by rank 5 costs nothing on no cooldown, so trades land even, not in your favor.

edits.before: At 6 you finally get a window: Cannon Barrage lets you zone his W walk-up and punish a dive, since his kill pattern needs an E-flip to land before his shotgun knees can dump damage, and his R only executes you once you're already below the threshold. Drop Barrage on his approach when he commits, cleanse the flip with W, and Parrrley-detonate a keg to slow and peel out. Don't straight-duel him — Purge out-sustains your poke until your first item — so use the ult to deny the all-in and keep farming, not to force a fight his W shield wins.
edits.after: At 6 you finally get a window: Cannon Barrage lets you zone his W walk-up and punish a dive, since his kill pattern needs Disdain (E, 16s at rank 1) to land before his shotgun knees can dump damage, and Fear Beyond Death only executes you once you're already below the threshold. Drop Cannon Barrage on his approach when he commits, cleanse the flip-stun with Remove Scurvy, and Parrrley-detonate a keg to slow and peel out. Don't straight-duel him — Purge out-sustains your poke until your first item — so use the ult to deny the all-in, not to force a fight the Disdain shield wins.

notes: Packet defect 'Drop Barrage' resolved: it was a truncated reference to Cannon Barrage in mid, now spelled out. Not asserted anywhere: whether Remove Scurvy removes the suppression component of Fear Beyond Death (Riot text says only 'cure crowd control effects'), and whether a Powder Keg blocks Disdain's charge as a non-champion unit — both left out rather than guessed.
